reason: Both windows show coherent absorption minima: Ca K dips to ~1.0 at 5004-5006 (center 5004.9, ~0.7 Å from prediction) and Ca H dips to ~1.2-1.5 at 5046-5052 (center 5047.3, ~1.1 Å off).
